gloss: Tanabata bamboo decoration; decorated bamboo branch

definitions.gloss: Tanabata bamboo decoration; decorated bamboo branch
definitions.explanation: A branch of {笹|ささ} (bamboo grass) decorated with paper streamers, origami ornaments, and {短冊|たんざく} (strips of paper bearing wishes), displayed for the {七夕|たなばた} festival on July 7.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{笹飾|ささかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{笹飾|ささかざ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飾|かざ}ってあった→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: A large Tanabata bamboo decoration was displayed at the entrance of the daycare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}→願い事：14621_negaigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{短冊|たんざく}→短冊：13674_tanzaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{笹飾|ささかざ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結|むす}び{付|つ}けた→結び付ける：17205_musubitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: The children tied paper strips bearing their wishes to the bamboo decoration.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{笹|ささ}→笹：04407_sasa⟧ (bamboo grass) + ⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧ (decoration). A core symbol of the Tanabata festival; the decorated branch is traditionally floated down a river or burned after the festival to send the wishes to the heavens.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {笹飾|ささかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make Tanabata bamboo decorations
- {笹飾|ささかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display the decoration
- {笹飾|ささかざ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{短冊|たんざく}→短冊：13674_tanzaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to attach wish strips to the decoration

TYPICAL ORNAMENTS:
- ⟦{短冊|たんざく}→短冊：13674_tanzaku⟧: paper strips bearing written wishes
- {吹|ふ}き{流|なが}し: paper streamers
- ⟦{折|お}り{鶴|づる}→折り鶴：12782_orizuru⟧: origami cranes
- {網飾|あみかざ}り: paper-net ornaments symbolizing a fisherman's catch
